decision.reason: [ev-238c84f9b428] is a single bullet in the upgrade guide's "Start using v2 features" section. It only tells readers to follow the composition getting-started guide. It names no changed artifact, says nothing about a before/after or change type, and gives no condition for which environments are exposed or what happens if an operator does nothing. Writing any of the four aspects would need the content of the linked guide or a release note that states what changed in composition functions.
